svg.title: One conversation, three Grok Bots
svg.desc: You talk to the client assistant. The Invoice Agent ingests and checks invoices; the Regulations Agent investigates cases and sources. Each Grok Bot reads and writes through its own MCP connection to one shared platform. The platform stores accounting state and does not invoke models. Passes are explicitly requested.

g.text: Your assistant handles the conversation. Specialists handle the accounting work.
or opens a case for review.
Invoices · company facts · cases & answers · decisions · precedents · history
One shared record. The dashboard reads it; Grok Bots work through it.
Demo: each bot pass is requested explicitly; platform writes do not wake another bot.
Architecture illustration · the platform stores state and enforces rules; it never calls a model.
